src/handle/claim.ts: the holes

const claim: Handler = (_payload, { steps, move }) =>
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    // Step load: database, span handle.claim.load.
    yield* steps.load(Handlers.blank("load: the work this step does"));

    // HandleTaken: exit 10, HN-001.
    if (yield* Handlers.blank<boolean>("refuse HandleTaken when?")) {
      return yield* new HandleTaken({});
    }

    // HandleAlreadyOwned: exit 12, HN-002.
    if (yield* Handlers.blank<boolean>("refuse HandleAlreadyOwned when?")) {
      return yield* new HandleAlreadyOwned({});
    }

    // Step record: database, span handle.claim.record.
    yield* steps.record(Handlers.blank("record: the work this step does"));

    // The move claim, to claimed.
    yield* move();

    return { handle: yield* Handlers.blank("handle, a handle id") };
  });

abstract contract BudgetsBase is IBudgets {
    enum State { Open, Closed }                                              // the machine's states
    struct Budget { address account; address token; uint256 limit; uint256 spent; State state; }   // the fields
    mapping(uint256 id => Budget) internal budgets;                          // lives: chain

    event BudgetSpent(uint256 indexed budget, bytes32 indexed payment, address to, uint256 amount);   // the event
    error BudgetExceeded(uint256 budget, uint256 left, uint256 asked);       // your declared error
    error BudgetNotOpen(uint256 budget, State state);                        // the machine's wrong-state refusal
    error NotAllowed(address caller);                                        // from allowed

    function spend(uint256 id, bytes32 payment, address to, uint256 amount) external {
        Budget storage b = budgets[id];
        if (!IAccount(b.account).isOwner(msg.sender)) revert NotAllowed(msg.sender);        // allowed
        if (b.state != State.Open) revert BudgetNotOpen(id, b.state);                       // move.from
        _spend(b, to, amount);                                                              // your code, below
        if (b.spent > b.limit) revert BudgetExceeded(id, b.limit + amount - b.spent, amount); // the invariant, after every call
        emit BudgetSpent(id, payment, to, amount);                                          // move.emits
    }

    function _spend(Budget storage b, address to, uint256 amount) internal virtual;
}

const claim: Handler = ({ name }, { principal, steps, move, id }) =>
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    const records = yield* Records;
    const holder = yield* steps.load(records.findBy(Handle, "name", name));

    if (holder) {
      yield* Effect.logInfo("a claimed handle already holds this name");
      return yield* new HandleTaken({});
    }
    if (yield* steps.load(records.findBy(Handle, "owner", principal.person))) {
      return yield* new HandleAlreadyOwned({});
    }

    // The handle and its public page are made together.
    const profile = yield* Ids.of(Profile.fields.id);
    yield* steps.record(
      Effect.gen(function* () {
        yield* records.insert(Handle, { id, name, owner: principal.person });
        yield* records.insert(Profile, { id: profile, handle: id, links: [] });
      }),
    );

    yield* move();
    return { handle: id };
  });
